bullets.text: Full-year CR 91.6 vs 94.6 in 2008; ROE 21.4%; net income over $1B; Commercial Auto CR 85.8; Personal Lines profitable in 48 of 51 jurisdictions; personal auto CR 93–94 in both channels.

Comprehensive income $1.75B ($2.61/share); investment return 12.5%; book value +37% to $8.55/share; debt-to-capital 27.5%; preferred stock unrealized gains $533M; $0.1613/share dividend declared; 11.1M shares repurchased.
Claim frequency escalation was more benign than estimated, aiding margins; prior-year favorable reserve development lowered CR by ~1 pt; PIP coverage showed aggressive loss trends in several states.

Some competitors increased rates above loss-cost trends; Progressive was comfortable holding rate levels; accident-year results indicated price adequacy; new measures presented agents with the best rate options available for consumers.

Personal Lines policy count up >1M over 2006 (+639k auto); multi-product household segment policies grew >100% in Agency and Direct; Direct auto customers +13%; Agency auto PIF reversed multi-year decline.
Written premium surpassed $14B; Direct top line grew 11%, dampened by average written premium falling 4%; Agency average written premium flat; Commercial Auto premiums down >$360M compared to 2006.

Q2 Claims management restructuring adjusted management scope; run-rate LAE ratio ended the year ~1 pt lower; settlement quality improved on prior highest measures; planned 2010 IT spending was below 2006 levels.

Buzz seemed to stem from 'Flo', whose consumer recognition and appeal was high; Flo provided an internal model of brand ambassadorship; Forrester recognized Progressive's website as best Brand Building Web site across financial services.

Direct represented ~43% of personal auto PIF (+13% customer growth); Agency auto saw late-Q2 application growth and reversed multi-year PIF declines; dual-channel access was viewed as a significant strategic advantage.

Expanded multi-product household offerings with three companion renters/homeowners relationships; launched Internet-only personal auto in Australia before year end; initiated sale of Professional Liability Group interest to ABA affiliate partner.
